description: Search current Australian mobile, prepaid, mobile broadband and nbn home internet plans from providers listed on Wireless Choices. Filter by price, included data, network, speed tier, contract and features. Results are ordered by lowest ongoing price among matching plans and each one carries the date it was last updated on Wireless Choices. Returns up to 10 plans, each with a link to its detail page; use offset for the next plans among the first 50 matches. Use list_providers first if you are unsure which providers exist.

contract_months.description: Contract term in months. 0 = month-to-month, with no fixed-term contract. Leave out unless the user asks about contract length

expiry_days.description: Recharge length in days. Prepaid and mobile broadband only. 28 and 30 are different lengths and match exactly; 180 covers recharges of 180 to 186 days and 365 covers 360 to 365 days

features.description: All listed features must be included. Mobile, prepaid and mobile broadband only; not valid with internet

max_price_aud.description: Ongoing price ceiling in AUD per billing period

min_data_gb.description: Minimum included data in GB; ignored for unlimited plans

network.description: Mobile network the provider sells access to. Mobile, prepaid and mobile broadband only; not valid with internet. Use only when the user asks for plans on a network; a named provider goes in provider_slug

offset.description: Skip this many matches, to see the next plans in the same order. Pass next_offset from the previous result. Only the first 50 matches can be paged

provider_slug.description: Restrict to one provider. Use when the user names a provider, e.g. telstra, optus, boost-mobile; slugs are listed by list_providers

sort.description: price = lowest ongoing price first (default); data = most data first; value = lowest price per GB first

speed_tier.description: nbn speed tier in Mbps, internet only

name: search_plans

catalogue_updated.description: Date the catalogue copy was generated, ISO date

contract_note.description: Present only when the search filtered on contract length: how many listed plans of this type have no fixed-term contract

error.description: Error code, present only on an error result

filters_applied.description: The filters that were applied, echoed from the request

message.description: User-facing error message, present only on an error result

next_offset.description: Offset for the next plans; null when there are no more, or the 50-match paging limit is reached

offset.description: Position of the first returned plan among the matches, from 0

contract_months.description: Contract term in months. 0 = month-to-month, with no fixed-term contract; null when not recorded

gb.description: Included data in GB; null when unlimited or not stated

max_speed.description: Full-speed cap, e.g. "40Mbps"; null when none is recorded

speed_after_allowance.description: Throttle applied after the included data (postpaid and mobile broadband only)

first_12_months_cost_aud.description: Monthly postpaid and internet plans only, never prepaid: offer months at the offer price, the rest at the standard price, with any announced price rise counted from its start date

modem_included.description: True only when a modem is in the plan price. False does not mean the provider sells no modem; read modem_label

modem_label.description: Internet plans: the modem position as recorded, e.g. "BYO modem, or buy from $216"

network.description: Network the provider sells access to (mobile types) or technology label (internet)

price_aud.description: Standard ongoing price per billing period in AUD

price_period.description: "per month", "per N days", "per N months" or "per recharge"

price_rise.description: Announced price rise not yet in effect

promo.description: Current offer, present only while it is active on the Sydney date

eligibility.description: Eligibility condition as published by the provider

price_aud.description: Offer price per billing period; null for a bonus-data-only offer

recharges.description: Offer length in recharges (prepaid, mobile broadband)

terms.description: Offer terms as published by the provider

speed.description: Internet plans only. Exactly one of three forms is filled, chosen by basis: a typical evening speed, a typical evening range, or a provider-stated maximum

stated_max_down_mbps.description: Provider-stated maximum download speed, for plans with no published typical figure. Not a typical speed

typical_evening_down_mbps.description: Typical evening download speed. Filled only when the provider publishes a single busy-period figure

typical_range_down_max_mbps.description: High end of the published typical evening download range. Not a typical speed on its own

typical_range_down_min_mbps.description: Low end of the published typical evening download range

updated_on.description: Date Wireless Choices last recorded a change to the plan, ISO date

url.description: Plan page on wirelesschoices.com.au with UTM parameters

ranking_method.description: The ordering applied to the results, in words

title: Search Australian telco plans
